description.value: Best Western The Westerly Hotel & Convention Centre is a full-service branded hotel on Cliffe Avenue in Courtenay, the main commercial hub of the Comox Valley on Vancouver Island. The property includes an on-site bar and lounge and a restaurant, giving it more infrastructure than a typical roadside motel. Courtenay sits at the intersection of cycling routes connecting the Comox Valley communities, making this a central overnight option for touring cyclists moving through the region.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is from the Best Western central booking system and confirms the property at 1590 Cliffe Avenue, Courtenay, BC V9N 2K4; page amenity filter tags ('free-breakfast', 'free-high-speed-internet') and body text ('cozy bar and lounge', 'restaurant area') provide evidence for Wi-Fi and on-site food. No cycling-specific content (bike storage, staff procedures, laundry, tools, charging, etc.) appears anywhere in the website text or OSM tags, so all cycling criteria default to null. The OSM name 'Best Western Westerly Hotel' differs slightly from the website name 'Best Western The Westerly Hotel & Conv Centre'.
